canada.title: Joly 'convinced' Ottawa can find a path forward with Stellantis as talks continue
canada.summary: TORONTO — Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says she's "convinced" the federal government and Stellantis can find a path forward amid fallout from the automaker's deal to sell its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant to defence contractor Roshel.

canada.title: Edmonton to host 2028 Grey Cup
canada.summary: The Edmonton Elks and the Canadian Football League announced that the 2028 Grey Cup will be held in Edmonton. The last time Commonwealth Stadium hosted a Grey Cup was in 2018, when the Calgary Stampeders beat the Ottawa Redblacks 27-16.

canada.title: Third former Montreal police officer charged in misconduct investigation
canada.summary: Another former Montreal police officer has been arrested as part of an ongoing investigation into allegations of racist and discriminatory acts.

canada.title: LCBO adding police officers to more than 40 stores in security push
canada.summary: The LCBO announced Wednesday that it's increasing security in stores where there's a high risk of theft. That includes deploying paid duty police officers to more than 40 locations.

canada.title: Judicial recounts in 2 B.C. ridings confirm seats for Conservatives and NDP
canada.summary: Two judicial recounts in the B.C. election have confirmed the winners who were leading on election night, Conservative incumbent Kristina Loewen in Kelowna Centre and NDP incumbent Stephanie Higginson in Ladysmith-Oceanside.

canada.title: Ottawa taps Qatar to offer consular help to Canadians in Afghanistan
canada.summary: OTTAWA - Qatar is partnering with Ottawa to provide consular services to Canadians in Afghanistan.

canada.title: Police searching for truck suspected in fatal Winnipeg hit-and-run
canada.summary: Winnipeg police are searching for a pickup truck investigators believe is connected to a hit-and-run that left a 32-year-old man dead.

canada.title: 1 man dead after shooting, attempted home invasion in midtown Toronto: police
canada.summary: A man has died after a shooting during an attempted home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say. They said an unknown number of suspects 'forced their way' into a home and shot a resident during a confrontation.

canada.title: After torturing victim over missing drugs, Saskatoon man played VLTs, stabbed a stranger
canada.summary: Within hours of participating in a brutally violent homicide, Dillon Singler went out and played some VLTs at Market Mall in Saskatoon, where he randomly attacked and stabbed another man.

canada.title: One of Quebec’s most wanted fugitives arrested in Ontario
canada.summary: The 19-year-old suspect, who was the subject of a Canada-wide arrest warrant, was arrested by the London Police Service in Ontario on Tuesday.

canada.title: N.L. is pausing plans to bring in flavoured vape ban
canada.summary: The government of Newfoundland and Labrador says it's postponing plans to amend the Tobacco and Vapour Products Control Act.

canada.title: Elmwood hit-and-run victim dies, Winnipeg police looking for vehicle they believe was involved
canada.summary: A 32-year-old man taken to hospital after a hit and run in the Elmwood neighbourhood Friday night has died, and Winnipeg police are now asking for help finding the vehicle they believe was involved.

canada.title: Saskatchewan’s deficit forecasted to shrink to $784M, expenses and revenues up
canada.summary: The Saskatchewan government says its finances are improving but it's still forecasting a deficit deep in the red, with the 2026 deficit projected to be more than $780 million.

canada.title: Bargaining to resume between locked out Civic Centre workers and City of Corner Brook
canada.summary: The City of Corner Brook locked out workers on Oct. 20.

canada.title: Nova Scotia launches Support Our Troops licence plate benefiting military charity
canada.summary: Nova Scotia has unveiled a new Support our Troops specialty licence plate, with a $50 fee collected going to a charity that supports serving and former military members.

canada.title: ATCO blames Yukon billing issues on low estimates amid high heat use
canada.summary: An ATCO Electric Yukon executive told MLAs he's confident their billing systems are accurate — while an ongoing independent review examines low estimates made during Yukon's historic cold snap last winter.

canada.title: Heavy rains, storm surge, high tides cause ‘real drama’ along B.C.’s coast
canada.summary: British Columbia's coast is getting another weather wallop as Environment Canada warns of rain of up to 225 millimetres along much of the coast before the end of the day.

canada.title: Former Alberta justice minister Kaycee Madu cleared of professional misconduct
canada.summary: Kaycee Madu has had his professional misconduct finding quashed in a case that accused him of calling Edmonton's police chief to get out of a distracted driving ticket.

canada.title: Parks Canada worker in Yukon says trail maintenance already suffering, ahead of job cuts
canada.summary: Ryan Colpitts, a Parks Canada trail worker at Kluane National Park and Reserve in the Yukon, says maintenance in the park is already falling behind – and he fears federal workforce cuts could make it harder to keep visitors to the park safe.
